## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one thing
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a short `[Unreleased]` entry
- [ ] README or docs are updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Tests are added or updated (unit tests for logic, integration tests for VS Code behavior)
- [ ] Changes to `package.json` contributions (commands, settings, views) are reflected in the README and docs
- [ ] Tried in the Extension Development Host (F5) if the change affects behavior
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are included
